title: Potential Capabilities of 3DLD Technology: From Non-Destructive Welding Quality Control to a Digital Twin of a Polyethylene Pipe Joint
authors: Vladimir Bukin
abstract: This paper addresses the fundamental scientific and practical challenge of reliablequality assessment of heated-tool butt fusion welding of polyethylene (PE) pipesunder field conditions. Based on experimental data, the study demonstrates theinadequacy of traditional regulatory approaches (SP 42-103, GOST R 52779, as wellas international ASTM and ISO standards) that rely either on static weld beaddimensions or solely on welding machine data logging without verifying actual weldformation along the pipe circumference. A cyber-physical end-to-end quality controlsystem is proposed, integrating circumferential 3D Laser Diagnostics (3DLD) withDynamic Site-Specific Calibration (DSSC). Through a retrospective analysis of fullcircumferential 2D and 3D weld replicas of Ø 160 × 14.6 mm (PE 100 SDR 11) pipejoints correlated with tensile test results per GOST R 52779, comprehensivegeometric quality criteria—relative profile discrepancy (Kn), groove root fillet radius(Rc), and bead convergence angle (αz)—are verified, and three stable geometricstates of a welded joint (defect-free, locally unstable, and critically defective) areidentified. The strategic significance of 3DLD technology is demonstrated as a toolfor automatically generating digital twins (3D/2D replicas) of welded joints forinclusion in the executive pipeline passport and for residual service life monitoring.Keywords: butt fusion welding of polyethylene pipes, non-destructive testing, 3DLDtechnology, 3D laser scanning, Dynamic Site-Specific Calibration (DSSC), weld beadgeometry, stress concentrator, weld digital twin, pipeline passport.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

zh-Hans.title: 3DLD技术的潜在能力：从无损焊接质量控制到聚乙烯管道接头数字孪生
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文探讨了现场条件下聚乙烯（PE）管道热板对接熔焊质量可靠评估这一基础性科学与实践难题。基于实验数据，本研究表明，传统规范方法（SP 42-103、GOST R 52779以及国际ASTM和ISO标准）存在不足：这些方法要么依赖静态焊接翻边尺寸，要么仅依赖焊机数据记录，而不验证沿管道圆周的实际焊缝成形情况。本文提出了一种信息物理融合的端到端质量控制系统，将全周向三维激光诊断（3DLD）与动态现场特定校准（DSSC）相结合。通过对Ø 160 × 14.6 mm（PE 100 SDR 11）管道接头的全周向二维和三维焊缝复型进行回顾性分析，并将其与按照GOST R 52779开展的拉伸试验结果关联，验证了综合几何质量判据——相对轮廓差异（Kn）、坡口根部圆角半径（Rc）和翻边会聚角（αz），并识别出焊接接头的三种稳定几何状态：无缺陷、局部不稳定和严重缺陷。研究展示了3DLD技术作为自动生成焊接接头数字孪生（3D/2D复型）工具的战略意义，所生成的数字孪生可纳入管道竣工技术档案，并用于剩余使用寿命监测。关键词：聚乙烯管道对接熔焊、无损检测、3DLD技术、三维激光扫描、动态现场特定校准（DSSC）、焊接翻边几何形貌、应力集中源、焊缝数字孪生、管道技术档案。

infographic.key_insight: 全周向三维激光诊断（3DLD）能够揭示与接头质量相关的聚乙烯对接熔焊焊缝几何特征，而仅凭静态翻边尺寸或焊机日志可能无法发现这些特征。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 将3DLD与动态现场特定校准（DSSC）相结合，有望支持现场质量控制，并创建用于管道档案和使用寿命监测的焊缝数字孪生。
method: 分析全周向二维和三维焊缝复型。
将相对轮廓差异（Kn）、坡口根部圆角半径（Rc）和翻边会聚角（αz）与拉伸试验结果进行关联。
将接头分类为无缺陷、局部不稳定或严重缺陷。
infographic.evidence_signal: 对Ø160 × 14.6 mm PE 100 SDR 11管道接头的回顾性分析，将复型几何特征与按照GOST R 52779开展的拉伸试验结果进行了关联，为三种几何质量状态提供了支持。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation and neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection for robust HDPE joints by predicting thermal response, axial forces and defect formation.
method: Develop a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of heat, material flow and weld defects.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force data.
Combine simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation showed good agreement with CEL predictions; ANN R² values ranged from 0.91 to 0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive accuracy outside the tested welding parameters and preheating conditions remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底面预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过与实验数据对比验证，CEL数值模型在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出很高的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度并稳定垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减小厚度方向的温度梯度并稳定轴向力分布。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明模型在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图谱，标示出有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热条件下获得了最优工况，而在1000 rpm且无预热条件下，由于形成虫洞缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备性能稳定可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的融合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该技术在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，在所测试的HDPE搅拌摩擦焊工况中确定了最优条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C底面预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架通过预测热响应、轴向力和缺陷形成，为获得性能稳定可靠的HDPE接头提供工艺窗口选择支持。
method: 建立描述热行为、材料流动和焊接缺陷的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型。
利用实验温度和轴向力数据训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
结合模拟与ANN预测结果，绘制有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口图谱。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证结果与CEL预测结果具有良好的一致性；ANN的R²值介于0.91至0.99之间，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 在所测试的焊接参数和预热条件范围之外，预测精度尚未得到确认。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY delivered higher hardness and corrosion resistance, while 80Ni20Cr provided better particle-erosion resistance on Al 6061-T6.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should reflect the dominant damage mode: NiCrAlY for hardness and saline corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.
method: Deposited 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation-gun spraying.
Characterised microstructure, phases, roughness and hardness using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM and nanoindentation.
Evaluated saline corrosion, wettability and solid-particle erosion.
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY reached 7895.36 MPa hardness versus 780.11 MPa for 80Ni20Cr, with corrosion rates of 0.00567 and 0.01427 mm/year, respectively, versus 0.5185 mm/year for bare aluminium.
infographic.watch_item: Room-temperature corrosion tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl and one erosion condition (90° impact, 40 m/s, 5 min) do not establish long-term service life or performance across operating conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性和抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒组织。AFM测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而80Ni20Cr的硬度为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基体的硬度为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY表现出超疏水性，80Ni20Cr表现出接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度为90°、速度为40 m/s、持续时间为5 min的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性能，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

infographic.key_insight: 在Al 6061-T6上，D-Gun喷涂的NiCrAlY具有更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性能，而80Ni20Cr具有更好的抗颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层选择应依据主导损伤模式：在所测试的条件下，若侧重硬度和盐溶液中的耐腐蚀性能，可选择NiCrAlY；若侧重抗冲蚀性能，可选择80Ni20Cr。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂在Al 6061-T6上沉积80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层。
采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM和纳米压痕表征微观组织、物相、粗糙度和硬度。
评估盐溶液中的腐蚀行为、润湿性和固体颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY的硬度达到7895.36 MPa，而80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa；两者的腐蚀速率分别为0.00567和0.01427 mm/年，而裸铝为0.5185 mm/年。
infographic.watch_item: 在室温下3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的腐蚀试验，以及单一冲蚀工况（90°冲击角度、40 m/s、5 min）下的试验，无法确定长期服役寿命或不同运行工况下的性能。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance among the four coating processes, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring both wear and corrosion protection.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation, HVOF and HVAF spraying.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction and volume wear rate.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在四种涂层工艺中，HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐蚀性，而HVOF获得了最高的硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于同时需要耐磨和防腐蚀保护的304不锈钢部件，HVAF是一种有前景的涂层制备途径。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr。

title: Electrodeposition welding for room-temperature equal-strength joining of aluminum alloys
authors: Yuming Xie, Yiran Wang, Xiangchen Meng, Ligang Wu, Yevhenii Illyashenko, Yongxian Huang
abstract: The rapid advancement of microelectronics and precision manufacturing has accelerated the demand for aluminum alloy components with minimal thermal damage and high load-bearing capacity. Nevertheless, existing joining technologies remain challenging because their inherent thermal input leads to performance degradation. In light of this, an electrodeposition welding method was proposed for thermal-damage-free equal-strength joining of 6061-T6 aluminum alloys. Electrochemical texturing pre-treatment was adopted to fabricate a uniform nanoporous oxide layer, providing nucleation sites, Ni infilling channels, and a mechanical anchoring framework for electrodeposition. Ni was reduced and continuously deposited inside the nanopores and the prefabricated V-shaped groove. The deposited Ni filled the nanopores and was mechanically anchored by the surrounding oxide-wall framework. The original interface was therefore transformed into a nanoscale mechanically interlocked transition interface. Al-O and Ni-O bonds were identified by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, confirming the contribution of chemical bonding within the interfacial zone. No obvious grain coarsening or softened zone was detected in the base material. The joint reached an ultimate tensile strength of 329 ± 6 MPa and fractured in the base material. A joint efficiency of 100% was achieved. The synergistic effect of mechanical interlocking and chemical bonding, together with the preservation of the base material by low-temperature electrodeposition, enabled thermal-damage-free equal-strength joining.

infographic.key_insight: Room-temperature Ni electrodeposition joined 6061-T6 aluminum at base-metal strength through nanoscale mechanical interlocking and interfacial chemical bonding.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The method offers a low-thermal-input route for joining load-bearing aluminum components where heat-induced softening or distortion is undesirable.
method: Electrochemically texture aluminum to form a uniform nanoporous oxide layer.
Electrodeposit Ni into the nanopores and a prefabricated V-shaped groove.
Combine oxide-framework anchoring with interfacial Al–O and Ni–O bonding.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish fatigue performance, corrosion durability, or scalability to larger joints.
infographic.paper_title: Electrodeposition welding for room-temperature equal-strength joining of aluminum alloys

zh-Hans.title: 用于铝合金室温等强连接的电沉积焊接
zh-Hans.abstract: 微电子与精密制造的快速发展，加速了对热损伤极小且承载能力高的铝合金构件的需求。然而，现有连接技术因其固有的热输入会导致性能退化，仍面临挑战。为此，提出了一种电沉积焊接方法，用于实现6061-T6铝合金的无热损伤等强连接。采用电化学织构化预处理制备均匀的纳米多孔氧化层，为电沉积提供成核位点、Ni填充通道和机械锚固骨架。Ni在纳米孔和预制V形坡口内被还原并持续沉积。沉积的Ni填充纳米孔，并由周围的氧化物孔壁骨架机械锚固。因此，原始界面转变为纳米尺度的机械互锁过渡界面。通过X射线光电子能谱检测到Al-O和Ni-O键，证实了界面区域内化学键合的贡献。母材中未检测到明显的晶粒粗化或软化区。接头的极限抗拉强度达到329 ± 6 MPa，断裂发生在母材中。接头效率达到100%。机械互锁与化学键合的协同作用，加之低温电沉积对母材性能的保持，实现了无热损伤等强连接。

infographic.key_insight: 室温Ni电沉积通过纳米尺度机械互锁和界面化学键合，实现了6061-T6铝合金的连接，接头强度达到母材水平。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于不允许出现热致软化或变形的承载铝构件，该方法提供了一条低热输入的连接途径。
method: 对铝进行电化学织构化处理，形成均匀的纳米多孔氧化层。
将Ni电沉积至纳米孔和预制V形坡口内。
将氧化物骨架锚固与界面Al–O和Ni–O键合相结合。

title: Interface formation and anti-penetration mechanism of fiber-reinforced aluminum-steel composites prepared by explosive welding
authors: Nan Zhou, Weitao Yao, Zhou Xiaofeng, Chao Cao, Jinxiang Wang, Jian Wang
abstract: Aluminum/steel laminated composites are promising candidates for lightweight protective structures because they combine high specific strength with good corrosion resistance; however, the interfacial evolution introduced by fiber interlayers during explosive welding and its influence on anti-penetration performance remain unclear. In this study, fiber-reinforced LY12/304L composites were fabricated by explosive welding, and their interface formation and ballistic response were investigated using experiments and numerical simulations. Optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy were used to characterize the welded interface and post-impact damage, while the S-ALE method and a Lagrangian finite element model were employed to reproduce the welding and penetration processes. The results show that fiber reinforcement changes the collision mode and produces a more irregular wavy interface. A rotational vortex forms near the fiber blockage zone, where severe local material stirring, with a maximum velocity of about 2600 m/s, promotes interfacial defect initiation. Under ballistic loading, the fibers enhance energy dissipation through bending, stretching, and fracture, while regulating stress-wave propagation and reducing local stress concentration. Consequently, the ballistic limit velocity increases by 11.53%, and the projectile residual velocity decreases by 9.9%–49.5%.

infographic.key_insight: Fiber interlayers reshape explosively welded aluminum–steel interfaces and improve penetration resistance through fiber deformation, fracture, and stress-wave regulation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fiber-reinforced LY12/304L laminates offer a route to lightweight protective structures, provided welding-induced interfacial defects are controlled.
method: Fabricated fiber-reinforced LY12 aluminum/304L steel composites by explosive welding.
Characterized welded interfaces and impact damage using optical and scanning electron microscopy.
Modeled welding with S-ALE and penetration with Lagrangian finite elements.

infographic.paper_title: Interface formation and anti-penetration mechanism of fiber-reinforced aluminum-steel composites prepared by explosive welding

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸焊接制备纤维增强铝-钢复合材料的界面形成及抗侵彻机制
zh-Hans.abstract: 铝/钢层状复合材料兼具高比强度和良好的耐腐蚀性，是轻量化防护结构的潜在候选材料；然而，爆炸焊接过程中纤维中间层引起的界面演化及其对抗侵彻性能的影响仍不明确。本研究采用爆炸焊接制备了纤维增强LY12/304L复合材料，并通过实验与数值模拟研究了其界面形成和弹道响应。采用光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜表征焊接界面及冲击后损伤，并采用S-ALE方法和拉格朗日有限元模型分别再现焊接与侵彻过程。结果表明，纤维增强改变了碰撞模式，形成了更不规则的波状界面。纤维阻挡区附近形成旋转涡流，该区域发生剧烈的局部材料搅拌，最大速度约为2600 m/s，促进了界面缺陷的萌生。在弹道载荷作用下，纤维通过弯曲、拉伸和断裂增强能量耗散，同时调控应力波传播并降低局部应力集中。因此，弹道极限速度提高了11.53%，弹丸剩余速度降低了9.9%–49.5%。

infographic.key_insight: 纤维中间层重塑了爆炸焊接铝-钢界面，并通过纤维变形、断裂及应力波调控提高抗侵彻能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 在焊接引起的界面缺陷得到控制的前提下，纤维增强LY12/304L层合材料为轻量化防护结构提供了一条实现路径。
method: 采用爆炸焊接制备纤维增强LY12铝/304L钢复合材料。
采用光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜表征焊接界面及冲击损伤。

infographic.evidence_signal: 该研究报告，弹道极限速度提高了11.53%，弹丸剩余速度降低了9.9%–49.5%，同时纤维阻挡区附近的局部搅拌速度约为2600 m/s。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71% compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni–20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% versus bare SA516 boiler steel, delivering the best resistance among the tested coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings could help protect SA516 boiler steel from high-temperature oxidation through denser microstructures and protective oxide formation.
method: Applied Ni–20Cr, Ni–20Cr+40TiC, and Ni–20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conducted 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized microstructure and phases using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: Laboratory testing linked improved oxidation resistance to reduced porosity, enhanced microhardness, and protective Cr₂O₃, TiO₂, NiTiO₄, and NiO oxides, while bare steel showed severe oxide cracking and spalling.
infographic.watch_item: Performance over 50 laboratory air-oxidation cycles does not establish long-term durability under boiler combustion gases, erosion, or service stresses.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在实验室模拟环境中，于900°C下进行了50个循环的空气氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）及X射线元素面分布分析，分析试验后的微观组织与物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重较裸露SA516钢降低了95.71%，表明其具有优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr基涂层可通过更致密的微观组织和保护性氧化物的形成，帮助保护SA516锅炉钢免受高温氧化。

infographic.evidence_signal: 实验室测试表明，抗氧化性能的改善与孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高，以及保护性Cr₂O₃、TiO₂、NiTiO₄和NiO氧化物的形成有关，而裸钢则出现严重的氧化层开裂和剥落。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, welding speed, and current affect molten pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability in distinct ways.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These trends can guide parameter selection for Invar welds used in aerospace composite molds, balancing penetration, weld width, and arc stability.
method: Numerical simulation of molten pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Comparison across laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: Within the studied ranges, higher laser power (5–6 kW) increased penetration and arc deflection tendency, higher speed (0.5–0.8 m/min) reduced penetration and width, and higher current (150–170 A) widened the weld and improved arc stability.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢的热膨胀系数极低，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多聚焦于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了关键的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大会提高反冲压力，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，加剧熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，提高焊接速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，在高焊接速度下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促使焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，在大电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和电流以不同方式影响熔池流动、焊缝几何形貌和电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些变化趋势可为航空航天复合材料模具用Invar钢焊缝的工艺参数选择提供指导，以平衡熔深、焊缝宽度和电弧稳定性。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
焊接行为高速摄影

title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Laila Sulyubayeva, A. Y. Zhakupova, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser remelting on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical properties, tribological behavior, and corrosion resistance of self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC coatings deposited onto AISI 321 stainless steel by detonation spraying. The coatings were characterized before and after laser treatment using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), instrumented indentation, adhesion testing, ball-on-disk tribometry, and potentiodynamic polarization measurements. SEM analysis revealed that laser remelting reduced coating porosity from 0.306 ± 0.014% to 0.15 ± 0.09%, accompanied by microstructural densification and a reduction in coating thickness. XRD analysis confirmed the preservation of the principal crystalline phases, including Ni3Fe, Cr7C3, CrB, and Ni3B, following laser treatment. The Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. Furthermore, adhesion strength increased by 19.4%, whereas surface roughness decreased by 19.2%. Laser remelting significantly improved tribological performance, reducing the average coefficient of friction from 0.535 ± 0.048 to 0.409 ± 0.086 and the specific wear rate from 2.864 × 10−4 to 1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m), corresponding to a 49.5% reduction in wear. Electrochemical measurements indicated a modest decrease in corrosion current density of approximately 3.0%, accompanied by changes in the morphology of corrosion-affected regions. The improvements are associated with laser-induced microstructural densification, redistribution of alloying elements, and preservation of hard reinforcing phases. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining detonation spraying with laser remelting to produce wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings for mechanical and power engineering applications.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光重熔对采用爆炸喷涂在AISI 321不锈钢上制备的自熔性NiCrFeBSiC涂层的微观组织、物相组成、力学性能、摩擦学行为及耐腐蚀性的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线能谱（EDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、仪器化压入、结合强度测试、球盘式摩擦磨损测试及动电位极化测量，对激光处理前后的涂层进行表征。SEM分析表明，激光重熔使涂层孔隙率从0.306 ± 0.014%降至0.15 ± 0.09%，同时伴随微观组织致密化和涂层厚度减小。XRD分析证实，激光处理后，Ni3Fe、Cr7C3、CrB和Ni3B等主要晶相得以保留。维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。此外，结合强度提高了19.4%，表面粗糙度降低了19.2%。激光重熔显著改善了摩擦学性能，使平均摩擦系数从0.535 ± 0.048降至0.409 ± 0.086，比磨损率从2.864 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)降至1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)，对应的磨损降幅为49.5%。电化学测量表明，腐蚀电流密度小幅下降约3.0%，同时受腐蚀区域的形貌发生变化。这些性能改善与激光引起的微观组织致密化、合金元素再分布以及硬质增强相的保留有关。上述结果表明，将爆炸喷涂与激光重熔相结合，在制备面向机械与动力工程应用的耐磨镍基防护涂层方面具有潜力。

title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding
authors: Tadeusz Kubaszek, Anita Słyś, Marek Góral, Marcin Drajewicz, Kamil Gancarczyk
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural evolution and phase transformation mechanisms in Cr₃C₂–NiCr cermet coatings (Metco 5241 powder) plasma-sprayed onto S235 steel substrates. Two technologies were used: conventional atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) with radial powder injection (single-electrode A60 torch) and supersonic plasma spraying with axial powder feeding (HV-APS, three-electrode Axial III torch). The HV-APS coatings exhibited nearly two times lower porosity (6.16% vs. 11.99% for APS) and significantly higher microhardness (1141 HV0.2 vs. 897 HV0.2). Phase analysis revealed the disappearance of primary Cr3C2 and Cr21.26Ni1.74C6 carbides in favor of supersaturated Cr-Ni solid solutions. In erosion tests conducted at a 90° impact angle, the two coating variants exhibited nearly identical specific erosion rates (0.20 mg/g for APS and 0.19 mg/g for HV-APS) and comparable damage mechanisms, dominated by fatigue-driven lamellar spalling and brittle fracture. However, in tribological tests (ball-on-disc, 30 N load), HV-APS coatings showed nearly 27% lower wear volume (2.85 mm3) and a reduced specific wear rate (1.90 × 10-4 mm3/Nm) compared to APS (3.90 mm3 and 2.60 × 10-4 mm3/Nm, respectively), correlating with their higher density and hardness. The obtained results confirm that the use of axial powder feeding in supersonic HV-APS plasma spraying significantly improves the mechanical and tribological properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings, although this advantage is not evident in erosion tests at high impact angles.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了在S235钢基体上等离子喷涂制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层（Metco 5241粉末）的显微组织演变与相变机制。采用了两种技术：径向送粉的常规大气等离子喷涂（APS，单电极A60喷枪）和轴向送粉的超音速等离子喷涂（HV-APS，三电极Axial III喷枪）。HV-APS涂层的孔隙率约为APS涂层的一半（6.16%，而APS为11.99%），显微硬度则显著更高（1141 HV0.2，而APS为897 HV0.2）。物相分析表明，初生Cr3C2和Cr21.26Ni1.74C6碳化物消失，取而代之的是过饱和Cr-Ni固溶体。在冲击角为90°的冲蚀试验中，两种涂层的比冲蚀率几乎相同（APS为0.20 mg/g，HV-APS为0.19 mg/g），损伤机制也相近，主要表现为疲劳驱动的层片剥落和脆性断裂。然而，在摩擦学试验（球-盘试验，载荷30 N）中，HV-APS涂层的磨损体积（2.85 mm3）比APS涂层降低近27%，比磨损率也更低（1.90 × 10-4 mm3/Nm），而APS涂层的相应数值分别为3.90 mm3和2.60 × 10-4 mm3/Nm，这与HV-APS涂层更高的致密度和硬度相关。所得结果证实，在超音速HV-APS等离子喷涂中采用轴向送粉可显著改善Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的力学和摩擦学性能，但这一优势在高冲击角冲蚀试验中并不明显。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Matching powder characteristics and deposition method to service demands can improve coating performance on machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS），分析了原始粉末的形貌以及涂层的微观组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制得的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制得的涂层具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和低摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些研究结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下运行的零件尤为重要。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在实现对搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头极限抗拉强度（UTS）的高精度预测，阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩下压量为输入变量，以UTS为输出变量。利用27个实验样本构建机器学习模型，并采用留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966；通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，进一步将R²提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations分析表明，焊接参数的重要性依次为焊接速度、旋转速度和轴肩下压量，所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变高度一致。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少为90%时所有焊接参数的完整可行范围，其中轴肩下压量是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为FSW参数选择提供了定量依据。

title: Effect of Laser Post-Treatment on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation- and Flame-Sprayed Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C Coatings
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Aiym Nabioldina, D. Yerbolatuly, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser post-treatment on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical, and tribological properties of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings deposited by detonation spraying (DS) and gas-flame spraying (GFS) onto AISI 321 stainless steel substrates. The coatings before and after laser treatment (LT) were examined using scanning electron microscopy, energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, instrumented indentation, and ball-on-disk tribological testing. The as-deposited coatings were characterized by a dense structure and low porosity, amounting to 0.306 ± 0.014% for the DS coatings and 0.433 ± 0.011% for the GFS coatings. Phase analysis revealed a multiphase structure consisting predominantly of a γ-(Ni,Fe) matrix reinforced by Cr7C3 carbide, CrB and Ni3B borides, as well as Ni31Si12 silicide. After laser treatment, the main crystalline phases were preserved; however, changes in the relative intensities of the diffraction peaks were observed, suggesting microstructural modifications during rapid melting and subsequent solidification. The mechanical response to laser treatment depended on the coating deposition method. For the DS coating, Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. For the GFS coating, hardness increased from 1096.2 ± 58.8 to 1121.3 ± 49.1 HV, whereas the elastic modulus decreased from 228.0 ± 5.9 to 187.0 ± 8.8 GPa. Laser treatment also improved the wear resistance of both coating types. The wear rate of the DS coating decreased from 1.939 × 10−4 to 1.465 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), while that of the GFS coating decreased from 2.419 × 10−4 to 1.476 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), corresponding to reductions of approximately 24% and 39%, respectively. Under dry sliding conditions, the coefficient of friction of the DS coating remained nearly unchanged after laser treatment, decreasing slightly from 0.627 to 0.620, whereas that of the GFS coating decreased from 0.623 to 0.582. These findings demonstrate that laser post-treatment can improve the mechanical and tribological performance of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings, with the magnitude and nature of these improvements depending on the initial microstructure formed by the respective spraying method.

zh-Hans.title: 激光后处理对爆炸喷涂和火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C涂层微观组织、力学及摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光后处理对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和气体火焰喷涂（GFS）在AISI 321不锈钢基体上沉积的自熔性Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学及摩擦学性能的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、能量色散X射线能谱、X射线衍射、仪器化压入和球盘式摩擦学试验，对激光处理（LT）前后的涂层进行了表征。沉积态涂层具有致密的组织和较低的孔隙率，其中DS涂层的孔隙率为0.306 ± 0.014%，GFS涂层为0.433 ± 0.011%。物相分析表明，涂层具有多相结构，主要由γ-(Ni,Fe)基体以及起增强作用的Cr7C3碳化物、CrB和Ni3B硼化物及Ni31Si12硅化物组成。激光处理后，主要晶相得以保留；但观察到衍射峰的相对强度发生变化，表明快速熔化及随后的凝固过程中可能发生了微观组织变化。涂层对激光处理的力学响应取决于其沉积方法。对于DS涂层，维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV增至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa增至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。对于GFS涂层，硬度从1096.2 ± 58.8 HV增至1121.3 ± 49.1 HV，而弹性模量从228.0 ± 5.9 GPa降至187.0 ± 8.8 GPa。激光处理还提高了两类涂层的耐磨性。DS涂层的磨损率从1.939 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N × m)降至1.465 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N × m)，GFS涂层的磨损率从2.419 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N × m)降至1.476 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N × m)，降幅分别约为24%和39%。在干滑动条件下，DS涂层在激光处理后的摩擦系数几乎不变，仅从0.627略降至0.620，而GFS涂层的摩擦系数从0.623降至0.582。这些结果表明，激光后处理能够改善自熔性Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C涂层的力学和摩擦学性能，而改善的幅度和具体表现取决于相应喷涂方法形成的初始微观组织。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

infographic.key_insight: Full-factorial testing identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide levels for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a process-development starting point: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF喷涂参数对Ti6Al4V基体上Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr)涂层质量特性的影响研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 对喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）参数进行系统优化，需要开展大量实验，以确定使涂层质量最优的条件。本研究采用比传统单因素法（OFAT）更稳健、更高效的全因子设计（FFD），研究HVOF喷涂参数对沉积在Ti6Al4V基体上的Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的影响。采用包含24次实验的两水平全因子实验设计（DOE），对所有输入因素进行评估。每次实验均测量涂层的响应性能。采用方差分析（ANOVA）量化各喷涂参数对输出响应的贡献。对于这一基体与涂层组合，喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等喷涂参数之间的交互作用对涂层性能的影响鲜有报道。因此，还采用帕累托图分析喷涂参数对涂层性能的交互作用效应。最终，当喷涂参数中的喷涂距离、送粉速率、氢气流量和氧气流量分别为150 mm、25 g/min、475 NLPM和205 NLPM时，获得了可接受的硬度、孔隙率和氧化物含量等质量指标。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling detonation-spray parameters to minimize coating porosity can improve long-term corrosion resistance on Q235 carbon steel.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数，并对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得最高平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，以及最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 增大O₂/C₂H₂比值可提高涂层的致密度、表面平滑度和结合强度，而显微硬度在中间比值1.1时达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 调节火焰气体比值为调控AISI 321钢上Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层的性能提供了一种实用方法。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统，在O₂/C₂H₂比值分别为1.0、1.1和1.2的条件下，通过火焰喷涂制备Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层。
使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂条件。
表征微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 当比值从1.0增至1.2时，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；比值为1.1时，平均显微硬度达到峰值1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要仅涉及一种基体上的三种气体比值，未报告长期磨损或腐蚀性能。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation spraying conditions control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle travel speed and spray distance can help engineers tailor coating surfaces for greater hydrophobicity.
method: Produce titanium dioxide–based coatings under varied detonation spraying conditions.
Evaluate surface roughness, coating thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimum, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct application of the reported equations.

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件的变化关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在制备过程中控制表面粗糙度、涂层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层具有最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间遵循反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间遵循抛物线关系。研究得到了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定使涂层具有最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工况。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂条件可控制二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离可帮助工程师调控涂层表面，以提高其疏水性。
method: 在不同爆炸喷涂条件下制备二氧化钛基涂层。
评估表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和接触角。
推导预测方程，并确定实现最大疏水性的条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，喷嘴移动速度与粗糙度和厚度之间存在反幂律关系，喷涂距离与粗糙度和接触角之间存在抛物线关系。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供最优值的具体数值、参数范围或预测误差，因此所报告方程的直接应用受到限制。
